{{Top|leg}}
'''Chlorine''' was a substance. It was added to [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] orbiting [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]]. It was also present in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] and [[Q'Maere]], the latter of had [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] levels of chlorine.<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>
